headline: Renesas Shares Fall on Margin Outlook Despite Beat on Q3 Revenue
summary: Renesas Electronics exceeded third-quarter revenue estimates, but its shares fell due to a weak profit margin outlook.
why: Renesas Electronics is a major Japanese semiconductor manufacturer specializing in automotive microcontrollers.

impacts.name: Renesas Electronics
impacts.why: Guidance signaling narrower margins led investors to sell down shares despite strong top-line performance.

why_moved: Disappointing margin guidance overshadowed revenue growth, triggering equity sell-offs.
